🃏 MiniSolitaire

The classic Klondike Solitaire: deal a tableau of cards, build foundations from Ace to King by suit, and use the stock pile when stuck. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Build four foundation piles from Ace to King by suit.
  2. Build tableau piles in descending order, alternating colors.
  3. Move cards from the stock pile when stuck.
  4. Only Kings can be placed on empty tableau spaces.
  5. Move face-up cards to expose hidden cards in the tableau.
